Zamazenta

Fighting

Galar · Generation 8 · Legendary Pokémon

Zamazenta is a Fighting-type Warrior Pokémon first found in Galar (Generation 8), and is classed as a Legendary Pokémon. It stands 2.9 m tall and weighs 210 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Speed (138), with a base stat total of 660.
